Final for Publication

SUBSTITUTE NARRATIVE AND PLANS
TYPE I Rezoning Attachment
1818-32 North Winnebago Avenue / 2327-29 West Moffat Street
From RS-3 and RT-4 to B2-3

#2310171

The Property
The Property currently consists of a vacant lot. The surrounding area is comprised of varying zoning districts including B2-3,

B1-3, B3-2, B3-3, RT-3.5, RT-4, RM-5, M1-2 and M1 -2. The area is improved with buildings with heights ranging from | to
6 stories and comprised of multi-residential and commercial uses. The property is also a Transit Served Location per the Transit
Oriented Provisions of the Chicago Zoning Ordinance, Section 17-10-0102-B(1), as itis within 551 feet ofthe CTA Westem
Avenue Blue Line train station entrance, and within 351 feet of the Western Avenue and 290 feet of the Milwaukee A venue
Bus Line Corridor Roadway Segments.

The Project
The Applicant proposes to construct a new, five-story multi-family building containing 30 dwelling units (including 6

affordable units on-site), with 13 automobile parking spaces, 30 bicycle parking spaces, and no commercial space. The
proposed zoning height of the building is 54 feet. To allow the proposed development, the Applicant seeks a zoning change for
the subject property from a RS-3 Residential Single-Unit (Detached House) Districts and a RT-4, Residential Two-Flat,
Townhouse and Multi-Unit District to a B2-3, Neighborhood Mixed-Use District. The Applicant is filing a Type 1 rezoning
application and seeks all relief necessary and as allowed by 17-13-0300-D of the Chicago Zoning Ordinance for the proposed
project, including but not limited to: 1) variations under § 17-13-1 101-B to reduce the required front setback (Moffat Street) as
measured to the projecting balcony, to reduce the west side setback to 0’ for the exterior parking spaces, and to reduce the rear
yard setback to 0’ to accommodate automobile parking spaces; 2) a variation under § 17-13-1101-A and § 17-13-1003-P to
increase the front yard setback as limited by § 17-3-0504-B to 6’2” as measured to the projecting balcony and 13°2” to the
building face; 3) a variation under § !7-13-1101-D to reduce the required number of loading berths from one to zero; 4) a
variation under § 17-13-1101-A and § 17-13-1003-R to allow for one entrance on North Winnebago Avenue and no entrance
on West Moffat Street; and 5)a variation under § 17-13-1101-Bto reduce the required comer lot setback from the side building
line facing the street to the nearest outside face of the rooftop elevator and stairway enclosure.

17-3-0308 Specific Criteria for Transit Served Locations Requirements:
1. The project complies with the applicable standards of Section 17-10-0102-B:

RESPONSE: The project complies with Section 17-10-0102-Bas the property is a Transit Served Locationas it is
within 551 feet of the CTA Western Avenue Blue Line train station entrance.

2. The project complies with the standards and regulations of Section 1 7-3-0504, except paragraph H if the project is not
located along a pedestrian street and except paragraph C if the land use is designated in a non-commercial use group,
pertaining to pedestrian streets and pedestrian retail streets, even if the project is not located along a pedestrian street or a
pedestrian retail street:

RESPONSE: The project is not located along a pedestrian street and does not include a commercial uses group, so

paragraphs C and H do not apply. As described below, the project will comply with Section 1 7-3-0504 standards

because:

© Building Location (B)(1); The Winnebago Avenue, side yard facade, is compliant as it abuts the sidewalk. The
Moffat Street, front yard facade is setback in excess of 5 feet from the sidewalk. Applicant is seeking a variation
under 17-13-1003-P to allow this condition. (B)(2): The building complies with this standard;

¢ Doors and Entrances (D): The building’s main entrance will be on North Winnebago Avenue. Applicant is seeking
a variation to eliminate an entrance requirement on West Moffat Street;

e Off-Street Parking (E): 13 on-site automobile parking spaces will be provided;

° Parking Location (F): Parking is located off the alley in the rear yard and obscured from visibility from the
Winnebago right of way; and

° Drivewavs and Vehicle Access (G): The Applicant will provide parking access from the alley.

3. The project complies with the general goals set forth in the Transit Friendly Development Guide: Station Area Typology,
and any other station-specific plans, designs or guidelines adopted by the Chicago Plan Commission:

RESPONSE: The property is identified under the Transit Friendly Guide station topography as Local Activity Center.

This typography calls for new infill development with a higher density of residential uses, height, and lower parking

ratios.

4. Residential building projects shall not have a numberof parking spaces in excess of 50% of the Minimum Automobile
Parking Ratio for the applicable district listed in Section 17-10-0207 with any fractional result rounded up to the next
higher whole number, unless additional parking spaces are approved as an administrative adjustment under the provisions
of Section 17-13-1003-EE; and

RESPONSE: The project will have less than 50% parking on-site.

5, The project complies with the Travel Demand Study and Management Plan rules of the Chicago Department of

Transportation.
RESPONSE: The project will comply with applicable Travel Demand Study and Management Plan rules

promulgated by the Chicago Department of Transportation.

The following are the relevant zoning parameters for the proposed project:

Lot Area: 9,842.76 sq. ft.
Floor Area: 25,833 sq. ft.
FAR: 2.63
Residential Dwelling Units: 30
MLA Density: 328.10 sq. fU*
Height: 54 feet
Automobile Parking: 13
Bicycle Parking: 30
Setbacks:
Front (North/Moffat) 6’2” as measured to the projecting balcony and
13°2” to the building face
Side (East/Winnebago) 0°
Side (West) 0’
Rear (South/Alley) 0’

A set of plans is attached.

*The project qualifies for an MLA reduction under 1 7-3-0402-B as the property is in a TSL location and all required
affordable units will be provided on-site.
